title: The Galois Alperin weight conjecture for finite category algebras
summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $k$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbb{F}_p$ and $Γ$ the Galois group ${\rm Gal}(k/\mathbb{F}_p)$. Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a finite category and $\mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{C}}$ the $p$-orbit category of $\mathcal{C}$ defined by Linckelmann. We formulate a version of the Galois Alperin weight conjecture (GAWC) for finite category algebras stating that there exists a $Γ\times {\rm Aut}(\mathcal{C})$-equivariant bijection between the set of isomorphism classes of simple $k\mathcal{C}$-modules and that of the weights of $k\mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{C}}$.
